name: 2026 Topps Chrome Football
lede: The 2026 NFL Draft class on Chrome Rookie Cards, plus today's stars and a deep insert lineup. What's in 2026 Topps Chrome Football, and what we pulled from it live on Whatnot.
facts: Hobby released November 18, 2026
2026 NFL Draft class on Chrome Rookie Cards, alongside current stars and legends
Rookie, veteran and legend autographs
Numbered Refractor parallels and a long list of inserts
about: Topps Chrome Football puts the new rookie class on Chrome. Inserts include Kaiju, Game Genies, Super Bowl at Night, Glass Canvas, Helix, Ultra Violet and Radiating Rookies, with rare Lightning Leaders and Vibes. Topps.com exclusives add their own parallels: X-Fractors in the Mega Box (6 packs of 7 cards), Red White & Blue Refractors in the Value Box (7 packs of 4 cards) and Pulsar parallels in the Hanger Box (one 14-card pack).
The rookie class includes Fernando Mendoza, Jeremiyah Love, Carnell Tate, Jordyn Tyson and Caleb Downs.
how: We broke 2026 Topps Chrome Football in a pick-your-team break on Whatnot on Saturday morning, November 21, and we have more on hand for upcoming breaks.

name: 2026 Topps Update Series Baseball
lede: The final chapter of the 2026 Topps flagship baseball set: late-season rookies, traded players and short prints, wrapped in Topps' 75th anniversary celebration. What's in a 2026 Topps Update Series Hobby Box, and what we pulled from it live on Whatnot.
facts: Hobby Box: 20 packs of 12 cards
1 autograph or relic card per hobby box on average
350-card base set with the Topps 75th Anniversary logo on every base card
about: Update Series rounds out the 2026 Topps flagship story with late-season rookies, traded players and the year's big moments. Hobby boxes carry exclusive Rainbow foil parallels (Aqua, Purple /250, Blue /150, Green /99, Gold /50, Orange /25, Black /10, Red /5 and the Foilfractor 1/1).

Inserts include Stat Stars, All Aces, All Kings, Heavy Lumber, Home Field, Autumn Ascensions, Cover Athletes and 1991 Topps Baseball, plus relics like Rising Rookie Relics and City Connect Swatch cards.
how: We broke 2026 Topps Update Series Hobby Boxes in pick-your-team breaks at Cheap Sunday Morning Breaks on Whatnot.

name: 2026 Topps Holiday Football
lede: Holiday-themed football cards: this year's NFL rookie class and veteran stars in festive designs, glitter and metallic parallels, and a full Chrome version of the base set. What's in a 2026 Topps Holiday Football Mega Box, and what we pulled from it live on Whatnot.
facts: Released October 23, 2026
Mega Box: 10 packs of 10 cards (100 cards)
Full Chrome version of the base set, with Refractors, Sparkles and numbered parallels to the Superfractor 1/1
about: Topps Holiday comes to the gridiron with glitter and metallic holiday parallels, holiday short-print variations, Dear Santa Autographed Relics, autographs, Holiday Spirit Variations, and inserts like Hidden Elf, Snow Globe Moments, Deck the Fields and Frozen Fields.
The rookie class includes Fernando Mendoza, Ty Simpson, Jeremiyah Love, Carnell Tate, Makai Lemon, Jordyn Tyson, Arvell Reese and Caleb Downs.
how: We broke 2026 Topps Holiday Football Mega Boxes in random team breaks at Cheap Sunday Morning Breaks on Whatnot, two megas per break, with teams assigned by Whatnot's random wheel.

name: 2026 Topps Heritage Football
lede: Heritage Football is back for the first time since 2015, putting today's NFL stars and rookies on Topps' classic 1976 design. What's in a 2026 Topps Heritage Football Hobby Box, and what we pulled from it live on Whatnot.
facts: Released October 21, 2026
Hobby Box: 20 packs of 8 cards (160 cards)
1 autograph or relic per hobby box
about: Old favorites like League Leaders and Real One Autographs return, joined by new inserts built around 1976: All-Pro Series, a nod to that year's Wonder Bread set featuring 2025's All-Pros, and The Expansion, covering all 28 teams from the league's 1976 expansion season. Other inserts include Sweetness and New Age Performers, plus Chrome Refractors down to Red /5 and the SuperFractor 1/1.
The rookie class includes Fernando Mendoza, Jeremiyah Love, Carnell Tate, Arvell Reese, Jordyn Tyson, Kenyon Sadiq, Caleb Downs and Cade Klubnik.
how: We broke 2026 Topps Heritage Football in pick-your-division breaks (all 8 NFL divisions) at Cheap Sunday Morning Breaks on Whatnot.

name: 2026 Topps Holiday Baseball
lede: Holiday-themed baseball cards: today's MLB stars and the newest rookies in festive designs, foil parallels and variations. What's in a 2026 Topps Holiday Mega Box, and what we pulled from it live on Whatnot.
facts: Released October 21, 2026
Mega Box: 10 packs of 10 cards (100 cards)
Every Mega Box: 1 die-cut ornament card, 1 autograph, relic or Chrome base card, and 3 Holiday Variation short prints
about: Topps Holiday dresses up MLB stars and rookies in snowflake-and-ribbon designs, with a full Chrome version of the base set, die-cut ornament cards, Hidden Elf inserts, Holiday Relics, Holiday Faux Relics (Santa Claus, Mrs. Claus, Elf, Nutcracker and Gingerbread Man) and Making the Nice List inserts.
The rookie class includes Roman Anthony, Munetaka Murakami, JJ Wetherholt, Konnor Griffin, Kevin McGonigle, Samuel Basallo, Jac Caglianone and Nolan McLean.
how: We broke 2026 Topps Holiday Mega Boxes in pick-your-team breaks at Cheap Sunday Morning Breaks on Whatnot.

name: 2026 Topps Allen & Ginter
lede: Minis, celebrity autographs, rip cards and a deep rookie class. What's in 2026 Topps Allen & Ginter, and what we pulled from it live on Whatnot.
facts: Released October 7, 2026
24 packs per box, 8 cards per pack, 12 boxes per case
2 hits per hobby box: autograph, relic, rip card or printing plate
300-card base set, plus minis, inserts and parallels
about: Allen & Ginter mixes baseball with celebrities and non-sports subjects. The checklist includes framed mini autographs, full-size autographs, relics, and rip cards: hobby-exclusive cards you can keep sealed or tear open for an exclusive mini inside. Parallels include Foil Filigree (Blue /150, Green /99, Gold /50, Orange /25, Black /10, Red /5 and 1/1s), along with Chrome, mini metal, stained glass and wood minis.
The rookie class includes Munetaka Murakami, Kyle Teel, Bryce Eldridge, Carson Benge, Justin Crawford, Owen Caissie and Trey Yesavage.
how: We broke 2026 Allen & Ginter in random team breaks at Cheap Sunday Morning Breaks on Whatnot. Because A&G has celebrity and non-sports cards, the break included a Non-Sports / Celebs spot alongside the MLB teams.
